relevanceRationale.transferable: Distinguishing an index from its value is broadly useful.

relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Empty names, first ties and frozen arrays make the output contract precise.

defects: The price/name domain and caller ownership were unspecified.

rationale: Bound ordinary read-only records, accept empty names and fractional/zero prices, retain first ties and null only for no entries. objective: Return deeply independent price snapshots without changing a frozen original basket.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: structuredClone and reference aliasing are current JavaScript topics.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Independent snapshots are useful in local history and undo features.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Deep versus shallow copies transfer to many state-management tasks.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: The stage adds one bounded nested-data repair to previous functions.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Preserving own keys and nested metadata prevents silently corrupted history.

defects: The junior reveal copied records shallowly and shared nested data.
Duplicate names had inconsistent first/all-match behavior across reveals.
The prompt generalized browser lazy inspection to this app, whose Console formats immediately.
Zero-price changes and shallow snapshots passed old checks.
rationale: Specify unique names, existing-name changes and bounded acyclic ordinary JSON metadata. Replace junior shallow spreads with structuredClone for the working basket and each snapshot. Explain returned-array aliasing separately from some browser DevTools behavior and the actual app Console. Test frozen inputs, own __proto__ data, nested independence, zero price and 100 by 100 histories. Own-key parity depends on the separately committed runtime fix #403; neither change is deployed yet. Define the combined quadratic upper bound and tighter output-copy cost rather than claiming a linear number of changes alone.

objective: Use cumulative call counts to find and remove a duplicated account update.

relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Preventing duplicate mutable updates is a practical debugging skill.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Separating observation from a side effect transfers to many domains.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: The stage repairs a clear duplicate call on a small local object.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Fractional aggregation and large balances distinguish incorrect reward arithmetic.

defects: The reference comment incorrectly said the global count printed 2 under every group.
The prompt claimed tiny elapsed time without a measurable guarantee.
Flooring per line and capping the returned balance passed old examples.
rationale: Explain counts 1,2 then 3,4 across two broken checkouts and that group does not reset the counter. Remove the universal timing claim, accurately note synchronous Submit virtual time and teach count increments as evidence. Specify mutable account points, preserved other fields, whole total flooring, frozen baskets and large exact integer bounds. Add two half-unit lines and a large balance result. These are isolated example objects and do not alter app rewards.

objective: Build an exact log-and-return helper and a safe stable first-seen bestseller ranking.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Logging wrappers, Map and stable sorting remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Observing intermediate aggregates without changing expression values is useful.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Own-key safety, stable ties and reference identity are transferable.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: The final foundation repair combines earlier aggregation and diagnostics.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Reserved and numeric labels reveal silent errors in otherwise plausible solutions.

defects: Reference and junior dictionaries treated inherited names as existing totals.
Object.entries reordered numeric names before stable sorting and broke first-seen ties.
Junior and senior bestSeller reveals omitted the requested debug calls.
Existing rendered-text checks accepted other console methods despite the requested console.log contract.
rationale: Use null-prototype counts plus explicit first-seen names on reference/junior boards; use insertion-ordered Map on senior. Every nonempty ranking logs totals and ranked through debug. Specify exactly one two-argument console.log and unchanged opaque return values, plus bounded frozen order data and zero/empty/reserved names. Add a restored console spy, object/symbol/undefined/falsy identity, numeric ties, own-key safety and 1000 records. Retain earlier cumulative tests, including deep snapshots, and leave every future broken starter function intact until its level. The supplied stable-sort cost model is explicit, not inferred from finite runtime measurements.
